paper.title_en: Thermodynamic topology and orbital dynamics of charged RN--AdS black hole with logarithmic corrections
paper.abstract_en: This study investigates the topological thermodynamic properties and orbital dynamics of the Reissner--Nordström anti-de Sitter (RN--AdS) black hole with logarithmic corrections solution in Einstein--Maxwell gravity. By utilizing the Duan's $Φ$-mapping theory, we investigate the topological classes within the generalized three-parameter Sharma--Mittal entropy formalism. Employing different thermodynamic ensembles, including the canonical and mixed canonical ensembles, we explore the critical, divergence points and heat capacity, which help us determine the thermodynamic stability of the BH. In addition, the Hamiltonian formalism is employed to investigate the orbital and oscillatory motion of neutral test particles. By utilizing the effective potential approach, we examine the effective force, the stability of circular orbits, and the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). We further analyze the trajectories of test particles and derive the radial $\left(ω_{r}\right)$, latitudinal $\left(ω_θ\right)$, and azimuthal $\left(ω_φ\right)$ oscillation frequencies, together with the periastron precession frequency. This work provides key insights into the fundamental nature of Einstein--Maxwell gravity. Moreover, these results provide a comprehensive theoretical description of the orbital dynamics of the RN--AdS black hole solution and may be useful for future high-precision astrophysical observations.
